title: SLADE: Detecting Dynamic Anomalies in Edge Streams without Labels via Self-Supervised Learning

problem.claim: The task is detecting anomalies in real-world graphs, including social, email, and financial networks.

gap.claim: Existing approaches typically assume static input graphs, whereas most real-world graphs grow over time and are naturally represented as edge streams.

narrative_sequence.summary: Anomaly detection has been studied for several types of real-world graphs.
Most real-world graphs are dynamic edge streams, but existing approaches typically assume static graphs.
The work aims to detect anomalies instantly, adapt to changing states, and address scarce dynamic anomaly labels.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the self-supervised learning method.
The abstract does not report experiments, datasets, baselines, metrics, or quantitative results.
The abstract does not establish whether the stated goals were achieved.
